verification_items.requirement: Support for 1-session, 3-session, and 5-session target generation in core prediction engine
verification_items.assessment: The production module app/prediction/target.py strictly implements single-session (h=1) target generation via generate_direction_targets(). Multi-session horizons (h=3, h=5) are not implemented in the primary target module; they exist only as research helper _target_frame() in app/training/regression_phase4.py.
verification_items.remediation: Implement parameterized generate_multi_horizon_targets(records, horizons=[1, 3, 5]) in app/prediction/target.py.

verification_items.requirement: Prevention of silent entry of excluded observations into target construction
verification_items.assessment: app/prediction/target.py blindly iterates sorted_records[t + 1]. If an unfiltered dataset containing the 14 excluded dates (e.g. 60-min Sunday Diwali Muhurat sessions or unverified New Year dates) is passed, target.py silently pairs Friday regular close with Sunday 1-hour close without warning.
verification_items.remediation: Create an authoritative NIFTY 50 research data loader that strictly filters inclusion_status == 'INCLUDED' before invoking target generation.

verification_items.requirement: Zero calendar-day arithmetic in session horizons
verification_items.assessment: Targets use sequence index stepping (sorted_records[t + 1]), not calendar timedelta (e.g. date + 1 day). Weekends and exchange holidays are naturally bridged as consecutive available sessions.

verification_items.requirement: Correct handling of missing future targets at series tail
verification_items.assessment: In app/prediction/target.py, the final session t=N-1 strictly receives None for target_return, target_direction, and target_binary. In regression_phase4.py, frame['close'].shift(-horizon) generates NaN for the final h rows.
verification_items.remediation: Ensure tail NaN drop is enforced across all multi-horizon outputs.

verification_items.requirement: Zero future information in feature calculations
verification_items.assessment: Feature matrix assembly strictly enforces FORBIDDEN_FEATURE_PATTERNS ('target', 'next_', 'future', 'outcome') to prevent forward leakage.

verification_items.requirement: Feature availability strictly matches prediction timestamp
verification_items.assessment: All technical indicators (SMA, EMA, RSI, MACD, Bollinger, ATR) evaluate over historical rolling intervals ending at session close t.

specification_vs_implementation_differen.specification: baseline_validation_specification.md specifies unified multi-horizon targets for h=1, 3, 5 sessions.
specification_vs_implementation_differen.actual_implementation: app/prediction/target.py only supports h=1. Horizons h=3 and h=5 only exist in isolated research script app/training/regression_phase4.py.

specification_vs_implementation_differen.specification: Excluded observations (14 sessions) must be barred from intervening in target calculations.
specification_vs_implementation_differen.actual_implementation: Target generation functions have no awareness of inclusion_status; they assume pre-cleaned inputs.
